_readme: Edit this file to put your crew in the game. One entry per friend. Stats are 1 to 10 and should add up to 45. Drop a face photo at faces/<id>.png and it is picked up automatically (optional extras: faces/<id>_happy.png, faces/<id>_shock.png, faces/<id>_sad.png). Abilities: lock, sharp, juice, chalk, hedge, tout. Spots in the Lounge: tv, bar, pool, window, pacer.

bartender.name: VIG
lines: What'll it be? Advice is free. Worth every penny.
House always wins. I am the house.
Tip of the day is on the board. Fade at your own risk.

players.name: THE PROFESSOR
players.bio: Shoots threes, refuses to play defense
lines: This line is a gift!
I ran the numbers. Twice.
It's not gambling if you're right.
Hammer it. Trust the model.
players.worstPick: Lost a 12-leg parlay on the very last leg

players.name: BIG UNIT
players.bio: Dunks on everyone, shoots like a fridge
lines: Five units. No, ten. MAX BET.
Get that weak stuff outta here!
Who's guarding me? Nobody? Correct.
I only bet overs. Life's too short.
players.worstPick: Went max bet on a team that scored 61 points. Total.

players.name: CHALK
players.bio: Only takes favorites. Solid at everything, great at nothing
lines: Favorites win. That's why they're favorites.
Laying the points. Always.
Minus 900 is basically free money.
Never met a dog I liked.
players.worstPick: Laid -900 on a sure thing. It was not a sure thing.

players.name: SQUARE
players.bio: Bets with his heart. Plays defense with his whole chest
lines: My team by a million.
The public is NEVER wrong. Okay sometimes.
I saw it on a billboard, it's a lock.
Same game parlay, 14 legs, feeling good.
players.worstPick: Bet his own team to win the title. In the preseason. Every year.

players.name: SHARPIE
players.bio: Tiny, shifty, sees the play before it happens
lines: I got that number on Tuesday.
Closing line value, baby.
You're betting it NOW? Yikes.
I don't sweat games. I sweat numbers.
players.worstPick: Got the best number of his life. Still lost by 40.

players.name: THE TOUT
players.bio: All talk, all the time, 100 percent guaranteed
lines: WHALE PLAY OF THE CENTURY, link in bio.
I'm 47 and 2 this month. Don't check.
Guaranteed winner or the next one's free!
Fade me? FADE ME?!
players.worstPick: Sold a 'lock of the year'. Three times. In one week. All lost.

players.name: STEAM
players.bio: Fastest man in the building, moves like the line
lines: Line's moving. So am I.
Blink and it's minus seven.
Catch me? You can't even catch the number.
players.worstPick: Chased steam into a trap game. The trap was for him.

players.name: LATE MONEY
players.bio: Quiet for 39 minutes, then ruins your night
lines: It's never over. Ask my bookie.
Backdoor cover incoming.
I live for the last two minutes.
players.worstPick: Cashed out early. It hit. He has not recovered.

lines: Statistically, you shoot worse than a blindfolded toddler.
Statistically, I can pick you up with one hand.
HAHAHA
You bet with your heart, Square.
And you bet -900 with your rent.
…that was ONE time.
Tail me tonight, kid. Guaranteed.
I'd rather tail the bartender.
HAHAHA okay that hurt.

afterWin: Respect. Don't let it go to your giant head.
Covered AND won? Who are you?
afterLoss: HAHA I had the other side.
afterBadBeat: Ohhh that one HURT. Bad beat city.
I felt that slip rip from here.
night: Late games are the best games.
West coast tip in ten. Who's got action?
Sleep is for people who don't have the over.
